_comment: Brute (Revered) hero. Instant - {t}: Pitch the top card of your deck; if it has 6 or more {p}, the crowd cheers you. Whenever the crowd cheers you, create a Toughness token. Modeled as the payoff: activation cost TAP_SELF -> CREATE_TOKEN toughness; the pitch-top-card check and the crowd-cheer gating are simplified/omitted.
